_help: Camp talk with Eleanor. Her story advances one step per talk (flags eleanor_story_N).

story_1.speaker: eleanor
story_1.line: Look at this rubbing. The cartouche has been chiselled away, but the chisel marks are older than the paint around them.

choices.label: Ask what it means
choices.line: Older? So someone erased him while he was still alive?

choices.label: Tell her to sleep
choices.line: It's a scratch on a rock. Get some sleep, we ride at dawn.

means.speaker: eleanor
means.line: Or just after he died. As if they were afraid of him. Thank you for asking. Nobody at the museum ever did.

brushed.speaker: eleanor
brushed.line: Of course. Wouldn't want to keep the hired help awake.

later.speaker: eleanor
later.line: I'm still working on that cartouche. Ask me again when I've slept on it.
